name: SDF23 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field in the Subaru Deep Field toward several very distant galaxies, seen by Hubble.
label: sdf23-hubble
story: Hubble aimed at this patch of the Subaru Deep Field to catch several very distant, spectroscopically confirmed galaxies in a single view. Their faint light helps astronomers understand how the earliest galaxies formed.

claims.text: Program 12616 imaged spectroscopically confirmed galaxies at 5.7 < z < 7 in the Subaru Deep Field to understand early galaxy formation
SDF23 is one of the program's pointings, at 13 24 41.50 +27 26 23.0, listed as HIGH REDSHIFT GALAXY
Each WFC3 pointing was placed to cover several galaxies at once
